events.name: CPI inflation

components.label: Momentum
components.why: Stocks well above their half-year average signal confidence; well below signals fear.

components.label: Volatility
components.why: The VIX is the market's 'fear gauge' — it spikes when investors pay up for protection.

components.label: Breadth
components.why: When the average stock keeps up with the giants, the rally is broad and healthy.

components.label: Junk bond demand
components.why: Investors reach for riskier bonds when they feel safe — and flee them when they don't.

components.label: Safe-haven demand
components.why: Money rushing into Treasuries is a classic sign of fear.

components.label: Price strength
components.why: RSI above 70 means stocks are running hot; under 30 means washed out.
